visual_goal: Show facts flowing from many owners into vehicle data providers, out to dealer software and data clients, and back from dealer software as observations.
prompt: A left-to-right flow illustration. Far left, a vertical stack of three generic source boxes: a government building icon labeled 'Registers', a factory icon labeled 'Manufacturers', and a shop window icon labeled 'Portals'. Each of the three sends one arrow right into a large central hub box with a folder-of-records icon labeled 'Vehicle data providers'. Upper right, a laptop-with-car box labeled 'Dealer SaaS'. Two separate parallel arrows run between the hub and 'Dealer SaaS', side by side with a clear gap: an upper blue arrow pointing from the hub to 'Dealer SaaS', with the text 'identity, history, value' written directly above it; and a lower orange arrow pointing from 'Dealer SaaS' back to the hub, with the text 'observations' written directly below it. Each of these two arrows has exactly one arrowhead. From the hub, one arrow to the lower right into a box of generic office buildings labeled 'Data clients'. One two-headed arrow between 'Dealer SaaS' and a filing-cabinet server box at the far right labeled 'DMS'. These labels are the only words in the image.
alt: Registers, manufacturers and portals send facts into vehicle data providers, which serve dealer SaaS and data clients; dealer SaaS sends observations back and exchanges data with the DMS.

visual_goal: Show the two halves feeding each other: data makes the workflow valuable, and the workflow distributes data and produces new observations.
prompt: Two large rounded panels side by side, connected by two curved arrows forming a circle between them. Left panel, blue, with a database and magnifier icon, labeled 'Data half'. Right panel, teal, with a clipboard and car icon, labeled 'Workflow half'. Upper curved arrow from 'Data half' to 'Workflow half' labeled 'facts'. Lower curved arrow from 'Workflow half' back to 'Data half' labeled 'observations'. Below the right panel, one arrow down to a small group of generic dealer figures labeled 'Dealer decisions'. Below the left panel, one arrow down to a small row of generic office buildings labeled 'Data clients'. These six labels are the only words in the image.
alt: The data half sends facts to the workflow half, which sends observations back; the workflow half serves dealer decisions and the data half serves external data clients.

visual_goal: Show the nine-step value chain as a loop in which sale and trade evidence returns to valuation.
prompt: A horseshoe-shaped arc of rounded step tiles, open at the bottom left, connected by single arrows in reading order around the arc: starting at the lower left 'Identify', then up to 'Check', across the top 'Value', down the right side 'Stock', 'Advertise', 'Sell', then along the bottom 'Register', ending at the bottom center with 'Insight'. Inside the arc, a tile 'Trade': one arrow from 'Stock' to 'Trade' and one arrow from 'Trade' to 'Insight'. One thick orange arrow rises from 'Insight' straight up to 'Value', labeled 'sale evidence'. The tile 'Identify' has only one arrow, the one leaving it toward 'Check'. Tiles 'Identify', 'Check', 'Value' tinted blue; 'Stock', 'Advertise', 'Sell' tinted teal; 'Register' and 'Trade' tinted green; 'Insight' tinted orange. These ten labels are the only words in the image.
alt: The nine steps from Identify to Insight form a loop; Stock can branch to Trade, and Insight sends sale evidence back to Value.
